title: Fuel Metering Unit Delivery Nozzle — Installation
abstract: Installation of a fuel metering unit delivery nozzle, with the union torque, the cowl latch clearance check that applies to the higher rated installation and the leak check at idle and take-off power.

sections.purpose: This task gives the procedure to install one delivery nozzle on the fuel metering unit with the engine installed and to release the engine back to service.
sections.job_setup_note: Confirm the nozzle part number against the engine standard. The revised nozzle is two millimetres shorter and its swirl insert is different; fitting the delivered nozzle to an engine with the relocated latch bracket leaves the clearance unverified and is not permitted. New seals must be used at every joint. Plan the ground run into the task because the leak check at take-off power cannot be deferred.
sections.procedure: 1. Examine the new nozzle and confirm the part number and the seal kit. 2. Remove the caps from the unit port and the nozzle. 3. Fit the new seals and engage the nozzle in the port by hand. 4. Torque the union nut to the value in the fits and clearances table. 5. CAUTION: DO NOT REUSE A SEAL. A REUSED SEAL WILL PASS THE IDLE LEAK CHECK AND WEEP AT TAKE-OFF POWER. 6. Reconnect the electrical connection and remove the tag. 7. Measure the clearance between the cowl latch and the nozzle shroud at the closed position and confirm the minimum in the table. 8. Disconnect the drain rig and account for the fuel drained. 9. Close the fan cowl and remove the stay. 10. WARNING: CLEAR THE AREA BEFORE THE GROUND RUN. THE ENGINE WILL BE RUN TO TAKE-OFF POWER. 11. Do a leak check at idle, then at take-off power, holding each for two minutes. 12. Shut down, open the cowl and do a final visual leak check at the joint.
sections.close_out: Close the fan cowl and confirm the latches are locked. Record the installation, the nozzle part number and serial number, the union torque, the latch clearance and the leak check results in the aircraft technical log.

type_data.effectivity_note: All aircraft; clearance minimum differs on aircraft post MOD-168226

safety_precautions: Clear the area before the ground run.
Use new seals at every joint.
